# Steam Community

> > Steam Community is the central hub for gaming discussions, user-generated content, item trading, and game-specific community features powered by Valve Corporation.

Steam Community serves as the social and marketplace backbone of the Steam platform, connecting millions of gamers through forums, workshops, and community hubs for individual games. The platform enables content creation, peer-to-peer trading, and collaborative gaming experiences across Valve's ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- Steam Community
- Steam Workshop
- Steam Market
- Community Discussions
- User-Generated Content

## Core Community Features

- [Steam Community Homepage](https://steamcommunity.com): Central hub for the Steam Community platform with access to all major features
- [Steam Community Discussions](https://steamcommunity.com/discussions): Forum-based discussion platform for user conversations and community engagement
- [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop): Platform for creators to upload, share, and monetize user-generated game content and mods
- [Steam Community Market](https://steamcommunity.com/market): Peer-to-peer marketplace for buying, selling, and trading in-game items and cosmetics

## User Account & Personalization

- [Steam Wishlist](https://steamcommunity.com/my/wishlist): Personal wishlist feature for tracking and managing desired games with price alerts

## Game Community Hubs

- [DARK SOULS II: Scholar of the First Sin Community](https://steamcommunity.com/app/335300): Dedicated community hub featuring discussions, guides, and user content for the action RPG
- [Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Community](https://steamcommunity.com/app/2000950): Game community hub for the competitive multiplayer FPS with discussions and reviews
- [RimWorld Community](https://steamcommunity.com/app/294100): Community hub for the colony management sim featuring guides and Steam Workshop integration
- [Reverse: 1999 Community](https://steamcommunity.com/app/3092660): Game community hub with discussions, reviews, and player guides for the strategy game

## Optional

- [Shared Files Error Page](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails): Error handling page for invalid or missing shared file requests
